name: dispatch
description: Parallel model dispatch, route preference and cluster collation: four-dimension scoring recommends a channel (FlashX batches / Flash pool / heavy doubles / dynamic workflows), /route records the tier preference as the confirm-question default, /collate runs the evidence-graded collation pipeline (dual-track corroboration, P0/P1 full check, flashx P2 sampling) with a ledger.

description_i18n.en: Parallel model dispatch in agent-workflow mode: main agent commands, subagents execute and report back. Tasks are scored on fragmentation/dependency/scale/difficulty to recommend one of four channels: Flash pool, FlashX speed batches, heavy workers, or dynamic workflows for any cross-provider model.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 并行调度 + 路由偏好 + 群集复核：主 Agent 指挥、子 Agent 执行回传；四维评分推荐通道（flashx 快速批 / flash 群集 / heavy 分身 / 动态工作流跨路由任意模型+等级控制）；/route 记录档位偏好作确认问默认推荐项（点名即回答，偏好不免问）；/collate 群集报告分级复核流水线（双轨互证、P0/P1 全查、flashx P2 抽查≥30%、账本沉淀）。派发前确认模型/等级/并发数。
